name: SHN_OtaLib
description: Modular HTTP-based OTA + optional FTP firmware update library for ESP32/ESP8266. A class-based rewrite of the legacy SHN_OtaUtil: WiFi/network bring-up, HTTP firmware+filesystem update server, and optional FTP firmware upload as independent, testable components.
keywords: ota, esp32, esp8266, firmware, update, http, ftp, wifi, ethernet
